'''Kephess's Redoubt''' was a military bunker used by [[Kephess]] and his [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]] as their main base of operations during the [[Battle of Denova]]. When an enemy strike team tried to storm the Redoubt, Kephess opposed them with heavy walkers, Trandoshan Warstalkers and Imperial defectors. Nevertheless, the attackers prevailed and the Redoubt fell.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kephess's Redoubt appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Explosive Conflict" operation. It serves as a stage for the final boss fight against Kephess in his heavy walker.<ref name="SWTOR" />
